name: Nela Riehl - Après le § 19 - Am 23
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: 19a. Considers that labour mobility within the EU must remain balanced and must not contribute to social dumping or brain drain in less economically developed regions; stresses that legal migration cannot constitute a structural or automatic response to labour shortages and that priority should be given to upskilling and reskilling EU citizens; calls on the Commission to fully respect the principle of subsidiarity when proposing initiatives related to skills recognition, portability or labour mobility;
